notes: The 'in the room of' expression was kept whole on tachat and headed on the content word 'room' (rule 24); giving the closing 'of' to the following noun as a construct relation was the competing reading and was rejected, since the noun is governed by the compound preposition.
The waw before the explicit pronoun is unrepresented and the relative 'who' realizes hu, exactly as rule 17 directs.
'son of sixteen years' is rendered '... sixteen years old': ben takes 'was ... old' with the construction-supplied copula (rule 20), discontinuous around the numeral and the counted noun.
